name: Honeytoken Deception: The Ghost Ledger
description: A bank-of-the-future enclave has been seeded with decoy access assets. Recover the valid asset needed to reach the bank's protected record. The challenge runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the settlement record
tasks.description: Recover the protected settlement record using the genuine access asset. The challenge runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Map the bank enclave's services and compare the assets it publishes with its operational records.
DNS can carry more than address lookups; inspect the zone's records and cross-reference the asset list with the settlement evidence.
The identifier tied to the completed settlement is the one to use when requesting its claim record.
